label: There is a Kripke model with at least one world, a symmetric frame and a positivity assignment on…
paraphrase: There is a Kripke model with at least one world, a symmetric frame and a positivity assignment on which Scott's A1a, A1b, A2, A3, A4 and A5 all hold. So the premises of T3 are jointly satisfiable nonvacuously inside the AFP embedding; this says nothing about whether they are true.
